## Accessibility Checklist
- [ ] Keyboard navigation
- [ ] Visible focus indicators
- [ ] Form labels and instructions
- [ ] Image alternative text
- [ ] Color contrast
- [ ] Heading structure
- [ ] Accessible error messages
- [ ] Screen reader checks, where available

## Defects
Link any related bug reports.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Supported browsers have been tested
- [ ] Required viewport sizes have been tested
- [ ] Accessibility findings are documented
- [ ] Failed checks have supporting evidence

## Evidence
Attach screenshots, recordings, or audit results.
